ui_4261cc1e72bdcb33: Tariffs inokwidza mitengo yekunze, asi mitengo yevatengi inotsamira pamariji, zvinyorwa, kutsiva kwevanopa uye kudiwa. Tsvagiridzo yeNew York Fed yakaitwa 6 Gumiguru inotsanangura zvishoma nezvishoma kupfuura. Nhamba yepamusoro yemutengo haifaniri kureva kukwira kwepamusoro kwechigarire: inflation yegore negore inogona kuderera kana kuwedzera kwekutanga kunodonha kubva pakuenzanisa. Kudzokororwa kuchinja kwemitero kana kuenderera mberi kwemuhoro uye zvinotarisirwa zvinogona kuwedzera kumanikidzwa.
ui_825a86cc728d9569: Ongororo yeNew York Fed yaChikunguru yakawana mamwe mafemu edunhu achiri kuronga kukwira kwemitengo mushure mekubhadhara mutero.
